dct_description_sm: For growth management purposes, the building permits dataset includes all issued permits from January 1, 2014 to June 30, 2026. It is limited to permits that result in new residential units and/or new non-residential gross floor area (GFA). As such, this dataset represents a targeted subset of all building permits issued by the city.
